header.title: Security Essentials
header.description: Security essentials help protect your computer against viruses and other security hazards.

statusMessages.protected: Your computer appears to be well protected. All security essentials are currently configured and active.
statusMessages.warning: Check your security settings. One or more security essentials may need your attention.
statusMessages.critical: Your computer is at risk. Antivirus or Firewall protection is disabled.

firewall.title: Firewall
firewall.descriptionActive: Windows Firewall is currently ON and inspecting incoming connections to prevent unauthorized access.
firewall.descriptionInactive: Windows Firewall is turned OFF. Your computer is vulnerable to network intrusion.
firewall.recommendation: Recommendations: Keep Windows Firewall turned on at all times.

automaticUpdates.title: Automatic Updates
automaticUpdates.descriptionActive: Automatic Updates is set to automatically download and install high-priority updates for Windows.
automaticUpdates.descriptionInactive: Automatic Updates is turned OFF. Your system may not receive critical security patches.
automaticUpdates.recommendation: Recommendations: Turn on Automatic Updates to keep your computer up to date.

virusProtection.title: Virus Protection
virusProtection.descriptionActive: CentralFirm Antivirus is active and real-time scanning is enabled. Virus definitions are current.
virusProtection.descriptionInactive: Virus Protection is not running or disabled. Your computer may be infected with malware.
virusProtection.recommendation: Recommendations: Run a full scan regularly using CentralFirm Antivirus.

internetOptions.title: Internet Security Settings
internetOptions.descriptionActive: All Internet security settings are configured to recommended levels.
internetOptions.descriptionInactive: Custom Internet security settings are in effect.
internetOptions.recommendation: Recommendations: Keep the security zone at Medium or High.
